description: This Java source file implements a container for RMI (Remote Method Invocation) services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It initializes, starts, binds, and stops an RMI dispatcher that exposes services via RMI, handling configuration, SSL setup, and JNDI registration.

classes.name: RmiServiceContainer
classes.description: A container class that manages the lifecycle of an RMI service dispatcher within the OFBiz framework, including initialization, startup, and shutdown processes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with command list, name, and configuration file.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the RMI service dispatcher, sets up RMI bindings or JNDI, and configures SSL if specified.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deregisters the RMI dispatcher to clean up resources.
